_about: The build tag each firmware build carries right after esp_app_desc_t: app image offset 0x120, flash 0x10120 (lib/platform/src/build_tag.h). Little-endian: u32 magic 'UMHT', u16 layout 1, u8 dirty, u8 reserved, u32 commit, char[8] app set label. Read by tools/build_site.py (read_build_tag) and site/installer/board.js (readBuildTag); both run these cases.

cases.name: no tag (a build from before tags, or other firmware)
